newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re sees significant profit gains.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re sees significant profit gains.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co said it expected another significant increase in results for 1996 after 1995 group ordinary net rose 54 percent to 1,092 million francs ($868 million).

"Based on developments so far this year, we expect another significantly improved result for 1996, assuming there is no major damage from natural catastrophes or severe negative events on financial markets by the end of the year," it said in its annual report for 1995.

Swiss Re, the world's second-largest reinsurance group, also said it planned to consolidate recent acquisition Mercantile & General Re (M&G) on the 1996 balance sheet if regulatory permission is received in time.
However, it said M&G would only be consolidated for the portion of 1996 after approval is received.
Swiss Re announced in August it would buy life and health reinsurer M&G from Britain's Prudential Corp for around 3.15 billion francs. ($1=1.2574 Swiss Franc)
